# A background tab's news: a ring beside its name, on the name's line (the
# row has two), and only where its badge doesn't already say what
# happened there. Both ring the bell out of sight; the agent's badge shows
# it working, so its row needs no ring. Looking at a tab clears its ring.
type:printf '\033]2;RINGER\a'; (sleep 1.5; printf '\a'); sleep 60
key:enter
tab:new
type:printf '\033]2;AGENT\a\033]7501;state=working:app=probe\a'; (sleep 1.5; printf '\a'); sleep 60
key:enter
tab:new
type:printf '\033]2;LOOKER\a'
key:enter
wait:3
expect-news:1:RINGER
tab:1
wait:0.5
expect-news:0
